C09.question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?
C09.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE (
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-26') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER))
    - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-09-26') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date))
) = 25;

C09.question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?
C09.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-26
  (
    -- Age = year difference
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) +
    -- Adjust if birthday hasn't occurred yet this year
    CASE
      WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) > '09' THEN -1
      WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = '09' AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) > '26' THEN -1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) = 25;

C09.question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?
C09.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    (c.birth_date IS NOT NULL)
    AND (
        CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-26') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 25
        AND (
            CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) < 9
            OR (CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 9 AND CAST(strftime('%d', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) <= 26)
        )
        AND (
            CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) > 9
            OR (CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 9 AND CAST(strftime('%d', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) > 26)
        )
    );
